claims.claim: Incident River Mersey in the River Mersey (Aug 4)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 17 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
STEAMER SOMERSET, which left Liverpool Aug 4 for Balti-
more, was in collision in the River Mersey, shortly after
starting, with another steamer, and the Somerset returned
to her wharf at the Liverpool dock, where all the passen-
gers and cargo were transferred to the steamer Carroll,
which steamer was to leave on the 8th inst for Baltimore.
